name: Richard Muscat
statement: Photography is how I freeze mood and emotion into an everlasting memory. This is a small, personal selection of the moments I've kept.

about.title: About
paragraphs: I was enthusiastic about photography from a very young age. It provides me with an opportunity to focus on and creatively capture a subject.
I find my inspiration in a variety of subjects including destinations, street life and social interactions. It is my passion to time freeze the mood and the emotion into an everlasting memory.

contact.title: Contact
contact.intro: Questions, thoughts, or just want to say hello? Drop me an email.
